verdict_rules.Reproduced: Within the tolerance frozen before analysis; usually the precision printed in the paper.
verdict_rules.Partial: Outside that tolerance, with the same direction, the same significance when known, and a bounded relative difference.
verdict_rules.Not reproduced: Computed, but outside the rules for Reproduced or Partial.
verdict_rules.Not reproducible: Couldn't be computed from the deposited data.

cam4-2024-hpd.finding: All point estimates matched; uncertainty reporting has internal inconsistencies.
cam4-2024-hpd.evidence: Every graded point estimate met its frozen tolerance. The paper’s table contains confidence intervals that do not fit its p-values; the verdict applies to the point estimates, not that uncertainty reporting.

ee-2022-roedeer-sexratio.finding: Female share and the birth estimate match; temperature effects remain unresolved.
ee-2022-roedeer-sexratio.evidence: The birth sex-ratio point estimate reproduces, but its confidence interval does not. The paper prints conflicting sample sizes; temperature estimates depend on scaling the paper leaves unclear. An extra row in the deposit is a possible explanation for the prenatal discrepancy, not an established cause.

ee-2021-salmon-smr.finding: Conclusions hold; partial matches reflect last-digit printing differences.
ee-2021-salmon-smr.evidence: The audit attributes the graded last-digit misses to inconsistent rounding or truncation. It also found a date-parsing change that drops midnight temperature readings. Restoring those readings reconciles other model diagnostics but leaves every graded verdict unchanged.

hsr-2023-ei-happiness.finding: The age effect reverses; the gender result is sensitive to the significance threshold.
hsr-2023-ei-happiness.evidence: The age estimate crosses the no-effect value and loses significance; the paper’s Discussion also contradicts its table. The gender verdict is sensitive to the standard-error method near the significance threshold. Other estimates retain direction and significance but miss the printed precision. A likely scoring issue in the deposited happiness total remains separate from these graded results.

audit.cam4-2024-hpd: Re-run three times, identical. Same estimates by an independent route. No verdict changed.
audit.ee-2022-roedeer-sexratio: Re-run three times, identical. Matched in Python. Found the paper's table sample size exactly with no year filter.
audit.ee-2021-salmon-smr: Re-run three times, identical. Analysis retained with plotting and parallel execution adapted. Audit separated printing differences from a date-parsing change.
audit.hsr-2023-ei-happiness: Re-run three times, identical. Matched in Python. Flagged a likely scoring error in the deposited happiness total.

notes: Papers were picked to be workable, so this is not a reproducibility rate for any journal.
Audit categories summarise observations, including possible explanations. They do not establish why every discrepancy occurred.
Not verifiable from git: that reproducers logged assumptions before seeing results. The claims freeze is verifiable.
